{"id":1900825042,"question_id":3235,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1769684076,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"69 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1900825042/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Cost to Convert String I","memory":"117.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic: \n    using ll = long long;\n    using pi = pair<ll , char>;\n    unordered_map<int , vector<pair<ll , int>>>adjlist;\n    \n    void dijkstra(ll src , vector<ll>&mincost)\n    {\n        mincost[src] = 0;\n\n        priority_queue<pi , vector<pi> , greater<pi>>pq;\n        pq.push({0 , src});\n\n        while(!pq.empty())\n        {\n            auto[cost , node] = pq.top(); pq.pop();\n\n            for(auto it : adjlist[node])\n            {\n                auto[nbr_cost , nbr] = it;\n                if(cost + nbr_cost < mincost[nbr])\n                {\n                    mincost[nbr] = cost + nbr_cost;\n                    pq.push({mincost[nbr] , nbr});\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    long long minimumCost(string source, string target, vector<char>& original, vector<char>& changed, vector<int>& cost) {\n        int n = original.size();\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++) adjlist[original[i] - 'a'].push_back({cost[i] , changed[i] - 'a'});\n\n        vector<vector<ll>>mincost(26 , vector<ll>(26 , LLONG_MAX));\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<26 ; i++) dijkstra(i , mincost[i]);\n\n        ll ans = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i <source.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            if(source[i] == target[i]) continue;\n            int u = source[i] - 'a';\n            int v = target[i] - 'a';\n\n            if(mincost[u][v] == LLONG_MAX) return -1;\n            ans += mincost[u][v];\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-cost-to-convert-string-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1588}
